items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I don’t know if you know Joey from New York?

ctx.x: Most of the writing I’ve done is when they put the gun up to my head. When I have projects to do I would write some tunes for those kinds of things. Oh I actually got, there’s a record company called Azica records that Holly’s been recording for and they’re talking to me about possibly doing a record, which I’m hoping would happen, I would like to do one. I didn’t for a long time want to do one as a leader, and I really want to use Joey Baron, I don’t know if you know Joey from New York?
A piano player? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

MB: No, Kenny Barron is the piano player, and I want to use Kenny too. I want to use Kenny. I haven’t called Kenny about it, but I talked to Joey a little bit about it, and he’s interested. And Peter Sprague, this guitar player I think and do a quartet thing. So that looks like it might happen. Hal Leonard is publishing a bass book that I’ve put together. I just got the drafts back from them a couple of weeks ago so I’m looking that over. So that will be coming out — it’s a “How To Build Walking Bass Lines” kind…
